steps.label: prep
steps.run: mkdir -p "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main" && cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main" && cp "$AGENT_HOME/repo/packs/cable/"* . && rm -rf s && bash prep.sh

steps.label: stills
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/work/cable_main" && /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b cable.blend -P cable_render.py -- stills 50 27,67,155,328,431,617,732,1077,1140,1189,1281,1430 > st.log 2>&1; a=""; for f in s/f*.jpg; do a="$a $f cable/e2/$(basename $f)"; done; "$AGENT_HOME/node/bin/node" "$AGENT_HOME/repo/tools/push_preview.mjs" $a | tail -2
